page_title: JUV 1-1 BOL | Juventus v Bologna 27/08/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+7' Samuel Iling Junior (Juventus) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
90+6' Paul Pogba (Juventus) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger. Juventus will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
90+4' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Weston McKennie (Juventus), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
90+2' Jesper Karlsson (Bologna) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
90+2' Substitution. Dan Ndoye makes way for Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna).

90+1' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders. The ball is out of play and Bologna manage to earn a corner.
90' 7 additional min. will be played.
90' Oussama El Azzouzi (Bologna) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
87' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) says something out of turn to the referee and is shown a yellow card.
87' Paul Pogba (Juventus) is penalised for a foul. Marco Di Bello had a clear view and blows his whistle.
86' Samuel Iling Junior (Juventus) will deliver the corner kick.

86' Weston McKennie (Juventus) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Juventus will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
85' Thiago Motta has decided to substitute Michel Aebischer and he is replaced by Oussama El Azzouzi (Bologna).
81' Massimiliano Allegri has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) replacing Manuel Locatelli.
81' Today's match ends for Timothy Weah who will be replaced by Weston McKennie (Juventus).
80' 1 - 1 Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) jumps for a cross and plants a precise header low inside the right post.
79' Timothy Weah (Juventus) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
76' Adrien Rabiot (Juventus) collects a wonderful lead pass and as he has a lot of space, smashes a terrific shot from long range. His shot goes painfully close to the crossbar!
74' Substitution. Federico Chiesa did his best and is replaced by Arkadiusz Milik (Juventus).
73' Here comes the ref’s decision after the VAR review. It’s not penalty to Bologna as the referee indicates there was no infringement!
72' Thiago Motta appears to have said too much and referee Marco Di Bello comes over and theatrically shows him a yellow card.
72' There's a break in play and referee Marco Di Bello must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Bologna using VAR. This could be interesting!
71' PENALTY APPEAL after Dan Ndoye (Bologna) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
70' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
70' The Juventus players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
66' It will be a substitution. Paul Pogba (Juventus) is ready to enter the pitch as Nicolo Fagioli walks off.
66' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Samuel Iling Junior (Juventus) comes onto the pitch for Andrea Cambiaso.
61' The substitution is prepared. Tommaso Corazza (Bologna) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Charalampos Lykogiannis.
60' Thiago Motta has decided to make a change. Jesper Karlsson (Bologna) replaces Riccardo Orsolini.
60' A substitution has been made. Nikola Moro is replaced by Nicolas Dominguez (Bologna).
59' Nicolo Fagioli (Juventus) latches on to a lofted pass and strikes the ball! His attempt flies narrowly wide of the left post.

57' Timothy Weah (Juventus) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Lukasz Skorupski makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the left side of the goal.
57' Juventus work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
54' The goal by Juventus won't count as it has been disallowed due to offside on the advice of the video assistant referee!
54' Wait! Referee Marco Di Bello has indicated he is going to review the Juventus goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
52' GOAL! Bremer meets a cross inside the box and heads the ball across the goal, where Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) lurks and pokes it into the back of the net. 1:1.
52' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Juventus.
48' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
46' A pass from Federico Chiesa (Juventus) is intercepted by Lukasz Skorupski and the move breaks down.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45+1' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Juventus, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
45' Lukasz Skorupski is equal to the effort from the edge of the box by Nicolo Fagioli (Juventus), pushing the ball around the post to safety.
41' Nikola Moro (Bologna) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and immediately unleashes a shot which is wide of the mark.
38' Timothy Weah (Juventus) came close to scoring. He connected with a pass inside the box and perhaps should have done better than direct his shot straight at Lukasz Skorupski.
34' Nicolo Fagioli (Juventus) blasts the ball high over the crossbar.
30' Nikola Moro (Bologna) picks up a precise pass and attempts to threaten the keeper with a long-range effort, but it goes well wide of the mark.
28' 0:4 – the total goal attempt statistics. The current number of shots on goal is 0:2.
24' 0 - 1 Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) receives the ball inside the box, reacts quickly and without any problems stabs the ball low inside the left post.
23' Mattia Perin pulls off a great save to deny Dan Ndoye (Bologna) who, makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive towards the middle of the goal.
22' Bologna enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
17' Stefan Posch (Bologna) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Marco Di Bello ignores the protests.
15' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
13' Bologna failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
13' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Bologna, is intercepted by one of the defenders. The ball goes out of play and Bologna have been awarded a corner kick.
12' Marco Di Bello shows the yellow card to Adrien Rabiot (Juventus) for a heavy challenge.
9' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Nikola Moro (Bologna), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches wide of the left post.
9' Timothy Weah (Juventus) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
7' Timothy Weah (Juventus) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
3' The linesman signals that Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Bologna will have the kick-off.
Marco Di Bello will officiate today.
Show lineups The starting lineups for this match have been revealed.
